primary_checks.scope: Results, Figure 1, crosslinking, library preparation and selected analysis Methods
primary_checks.finding: Crosslinked residual antibody peptide generates sequence signatures; antibody choice matters. Figure 1 and Methods specify 254 nm, while Illumina RNA p73 diagram says 365 nm. Catalogue wording must remain provenance, not an unchecked physical parameter.

primary_checks.scope: Abstract, chromatin preparation and protocol sections 6-8
primary_checks.finding: ChIRP captures RNA-associated chromatin, then recovers DNA for sequencing. This original-method protocol reports several-hundred-base mapping resolution; collection p27 says single-base resolution. Do not infer read length or assay positional resolution from generic sequencing.
